description: This file provides functions for safely opening and verifying files synchronously, including checks for symbolic links, hard links, file size, and file type, with external dependencies on Node.js fs module and a local file-identity module.

methods.name: isExpectedPathError
methods.description: Checks if an error is an expected path-related error such as ENOENT, ENOTDIR, or ELOOP.

methods.name: sameFileIdentity
methods.description: Compares two fs.Stats objects to determine if they refer to the same file, delegating to an imported function.

methods.name: openVerifiedFileSync
methods.description: Safely opens a file synchronously with various validation checks including symbolic link, hard link, size, and type validations, returning detailed result object.

methods.name: isAllowedType
methods.description: Checks if a fs.Stats object matches the allowed type ('file' or 'directory').
